skill.displayName: Celeb AI-Generate Realistic AI Celebrity Videos & Images – API-powered
skill.summary: AI celebrity photo — place a person in a selfie with a celebrity or fictional character

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial public release of celeb-ai-openapi-skill.
- Enables generating AI photos placing a person in a selfie with a celebrity or fictional character.
- Requires a WeShop API key and HTTPS access to openapi.weshop.ai.
- Includes secure handling instructions for API keys.
- Supports uploading images, starting selfie runs, and polling for results via documented endpoints.
